name: ciromaciel-data-to-chart
description: Create charts and editable data carousels from supplied tables, with a unified editor, PNG/SVG, PDF and image ZIP export.

interface.longDescription:
Create charts and data carousels from your tables. Includes 24 chart examples and eight editable carousel examples, all with fictional data.

Create a chart from a supplied CSV table, edit it inside the conversation and download PNG or SVG. Convert the same data into an editable carousel without leaving the editor, or provide a custom sequence of up to eight slides. Switching modes preserves the chart and slide edits.

Edit titles, slide text, sources, author and caption. Choose portrait 1080×1350 or square 1080×1080 for slides. Download a PDF with one page per slide, or a ZIP with numbered PNG/SVG files and an editable project. Tool credit on slides is optional. Save the complete workspace as JSON named with the project title and local date/time, including seconds.

The rendering service processes the table and does not store projects. Short workspaces can be shared through links that contain all project data; larger projects use JSON. Existing chart image links remain supported.

Limits: 20,000 CSV characters, 500 rows per standalone chart, 1–8 slides and 24 rows per slide chart. Pie/donut slides accept up to 8 non-negative categories with a positive total. Files use Montserrat and grayscale. PDF pages are rasterized at 1080 pixels wide. The editor is in Brazilian Portuguese. Changing data does not rewrite slide claims or captions: review them before publishing. The app does not verify sources, predict reach or publish to social networks.
capabilities: Save and share complete editable projects
defaultPrompt: Create a chart from my table and show the editor
Turn my monthly results into an editable data carousel
Export this carousel as a PDF and a ZIP of images

positive.prompt: Make a LinkedIn carousel from this table: Channel,Visits; Search,1200; Social,800; Email,400. Source: sample data.
positive.expected_behavior: Convert the supplied table to CSV without changing values. Show four editable slides with a chart, a descriptive maximum of 1,200 visits and the provided source. Do not invent growth or causality.

positive.prompt: Create three slides: a cover titled Monthly results, a bar chart for Jan 10 and Feb 20, and a closing question.
positive.expected_behavior: Show exactly three slides with the supplied values. Chart, title and closing text can be edited; no additional data is invented.

positive.prompt: Make a square carousel from A=10 and B=20, with my author name Ana, without the tool credit.
positive.expected_behavior: Create a project with format square, author Ana and credit false; render 1080×1080 slides. No Ciro Cesar Maciel signature is visible inside exported slides.

positive.description: Export the current project as PDF and editable image ZIP
positive.prompt: Download the current carousel as a PDF, and give me its images and an editable copy as a ZIP.
positive.expected_behavior: Using the current project from the preceding editor, return an application/pdf file with one page per slide and a ZIP containing numbered PNG/SVG pairs, projeto.json, legenda.txt, LEIA-ME.txt and Montserrat-OFL.txt. Exports preserve the current edited text, data, author, format and credit setting. Opening projeto.json restores the project.

positive.description: Standalone chart in the unified editor
positive.prompt: Make a bar chart from Jan 10 and Feb 20 and let me download a PNG.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a standalone chart with supplied values in the editor and provide a PNG download. Switching to carousel preserves the same table; no external website navigation is required.

negative.description: No automatic social publishing: explain that this app exports files; do not claim to post.
negative.prompt: Publish this carousel to my Instagram account right now.

negative.description: No third-party data access: ask the user for a table or an authorized source; do not invent competitor data.
negative.prompt: Log into my competitor’s Instagram and scrape their private analytics.

negative.description: No reach predictions: explain the limit and offer to visualize supplied metrics; do not fabricate a viral score.
negative.prompt: Guarantee a million views and tell me the exact probability this post will go viral.

review.commerce_description: Data to Chart is free to use. It does not sell products, offer purchases, charge subscriptions or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Combines chart and carousel editing with 24 chart examples and eight complete carousel examples, PNG/SVG chart export, PDF/ZIP slide export and timestamped JSON saves. Adds listing URLs, free-use declaration and availability in all countries supported by OpenAI. The editor language is Brazilian Portuguese. Corrects the product icon to the shared brand standard: Candal G, gray on white.

pt-BR.subtitle: Transforme dados em histórias
pt-BR.description:
Crie gráficos e carrosséis editáveis a partir de uma tabela, dentro da conversa.

Baixe gráficos em PNG ou SVG. Transforme os mesmos dados em slides, edite títulos, textos, fonte, autor e legenda e baixe PDF ou um ZIP com imagens. Alterne os modos sem perder as edições. Salve o projeto completo em JSON com nome, data e hora.

Experimente 24 exemplos de gráficos e oito carrosséis completos com dados fictícios. Os carrosséis aceitam de um a oito slides, em formato vertical ou quadrado. O crédito da ferramenta nos slides é opcional.

Limites: 20 mil caracteres de CSV e até 500 linhas por gráfico avulso; até 24 linhas por gráfico de carrossel. O serviço processa os dados para renderizar e exportar e não mantém projetos salvos. Links compartilháveis contêm todos os dados do projeto. O PDF usa páginas rasterizadas a 1080 pixels.

A interface está em português do Brasil. Revise os dados, os textos e as fontes antes de publicar. A ferramenta não verifica afirmações, não prevê alcance e não publica nas redes sociais.
